change: Large local-image viewer with same-attachment-group gallery navigation, fit without upscaling, original size, bounded zoom, pointer drag, Ctrl-wheel, double-click, keyboard navigation, focus return and load-error retry

reference.adoptedEvidence: Fit without enlarging small images, gallery bounds, opener focus, 40px circular navigation/close controls and 36px bottom zoom controls. Independent implementation; static reference evidence is not runtime parity verification.

priorFailure.finding: Existing layout assertion queried the removed generic modal footer. It now checks the actual zoom toolbar and every visible button; title, overflow, keyboard, three zoom levels, restart and request assertions remain.

nativeRuns.visualBoundary: Interaction assertions passed, but dark native screenshots captured an earlier compositor frame. Not used as final visual evidence.
Capture waits for dialog and two drawing frames, then verifies native PNG dimensions against actual content size. Four final captures individually reviewed.

nativeScope: 14 existing attachment groups plus 2 image-viewer groups. Actual normalized imports, 8 local HTTP protocol variants, restart and complete backup/restore. New checks exercise fit/original size, 10–800% steps, Ctrl-wheel, mouse drag, double-click, gallery arrow keys and boundaries, Escape focus return, error/retry, dark 760x540 at 100/125/150% and unchanged draft/attachment/model-request count.
errorProbe: The rendered image src is temporarily replaced with invalid local data to exercise browser load failure and retry. This is a DOM probe; corrupt input decoding is covered separately by the existing worker checks.

priorAttempts.failure: First protocol send did not occur; retained new-chat draft still contained prior text and no selected provider. Focused fixture now initializes a valid local test provider before import/restart. Empty-provider fallback writes racing out-of-band setup are an inference from source and retained state, not a traced root cause.
Restart normal-close deadline exceeded; harness marked forced at 10021ms despite prior main-process exit observations. Cause unresolved; later passes do not prove a shutdown fix.
Double-click did not zoom after pointer capture. Moved the handler to the capturing viewport with image-bound hit testing; the two later complete native runs pass this same assertion.

boundary: Source and focused desktop verification, not a distribution release or full UI parity. No physical touch/assistive-technology verification. Touch pinch, rotation/flip, original-image export, original-document rendering and the remaining broad capability scope are not implemented by this change. Full regression and all distribution/hosted gates remain required.
